effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] Place 1 yellow or purple Digimon card from your trash on top of your security stack face down. When DNA digivolving, you may search your security stack for 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card and play it without paying its memory cost. Then, shuffle your security stack.
[All Turns] When you play another Digimon using an effect, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon whose level is less than or equal to the played Digimon's level.
xros_req:
[DNA Digivolve] Yellow Lv.5 + Purple Lv.5 : Cost 0
Stack the 2 specified Digimon and digivolve unsuspended.
